---
name: roll-dice
description: Roll a dice and get a random number between 1 and 6.
---

To roll a die, use the following command that generates a random number from 1
to the given number of sides:

Script is [roll-dice.sh](./roll-dice.sh) for bash/zsh and [roll-dice.ps1](./roll-dice.ps1) for PowerShell.

Replace `<sides>` with the number of sides on the die (e.g., 6 for a standard dice, 20 for a d20).
